Increase Light Crude Processing
SPRC is leveraging current oil market dynamics to enhance margins. With light crude prices converging with heavy crude, it is  now more 
economical to process a higher share of light crude, boosting gasoline and jet fuel output while reducing fuel oil. The refin ery is strengthening 
this advantage by upgrading its capability through the 2026 Turnaround and Inspections, enabling higher yields of high -value pro ducts.TargetProject Background

Overview: The objectives are to promote good governance in fighting against all forms of fraud and corruption by establishing an anti -
corruption policy, as well as monitoring, evaluating, and reviewing such policy; to declare SPRC’s intention to join the Thai  Private Sector 
Collective Action Against Corruption (CAC) by applying for a renewal of the CAC certification, to demonstrate its continued c omm itment as a 
private sector operator to conducting business with transparency.
Targets :  
1.Retain the existing Anti -Corruption Policy, which is under the approval of the Board of Directors, as the applicable policy, wit h a new 
review cycle of 1 year
2.Obtain approval for a 3 -year renewal of CAC certification

Corporate Governance
Overview: Cybersecurity remains a core pillar of our Operational Excellence Strategy. In 2024, we achieved ISO 27001 certification, 
reinforcing our commitment to global standards in information security management. Looking ahead to 2026, we will advance our  
cybersecurity through 2 key initiatives: 
 1. strengthening remote access security by adopting Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) to replace legacy VPN technology.
2. enhancing visibility and threat detection by deploying a Network Detection and Response (NDR) System for proactive anomaly  
management. Additionally, recognizing the growing risk from third -party ecosystems, we are embedding a robust process within 
our supplier lifecycle to identify, assess and mitigate cyber risks posed by external vendors and partners with access to 
company data or system.
Targets: In progress and to be completed in 2026
Action Plans:
         Year
•Strengthening remote access security with ZTNA      2025  
•Deploy third party vendor cybersecurity risk management     2025  
•Enhancing visibility and threat detection with NDR      2026  4. Cyber SecurityBusiness  Plan Governance Plan Climate Action Plan

Climate Action Plan
Overview: SPRC recognizes the impacts of climate change and global warming, which are intensifying and directly impacting the global 
energy sector. As a leading oil refinery in Thailand, we are committed to operating environmentally responsible businesses, p rioritizing 
greenhouse gas emissions reduction across all production processes throughout the supply chain. SPRC we are proud to partner with 
Thailand on its journey to a lower carbon future.  Our goal is to actively reduce the carbon intensity of our operations whil e continuing to 
provide the reliable, affordable energy that powers the nation's growth. We believe the future of energy is lower carbon, and  we look forward 
to playing a key role in supporting Thailand’s achievement of its goals of Net Zero emissions (2050).
Energy efficiency is one of the decarbonization strategy, the energy project initiative part of capital expenditure business plan to support and 
driving for energy saving in organization. Our short -term target (until 2028)  is to maintain energy intensity at 0.16 Tons Co2/ ton production.Business Plan Governance PlanClimate Action 
Plan
